title: OpfsStorageMeasured.v1
description: Emitted whenever the /system page or a sync cycle measures OPFS usage. Carries `supported: false` when navigator.storage.estimate is unavailable.

usageBytes.description: Bytes used. Null when the Storage Estimation API is unavailable.
usageBytes.markdownDescription: Bytes used. Null when the Storage Estimation API is unavailable.

quotaBytes.description: Browser-reported quota. Null when the Storage Estimation API is unavailable.
quotaBytes.markdownDescription: Browser-reported quota. Null when the Storage Estimation API is unavailable.

supported.description: Whether navigator.storage.estimate() returned a usable measurement.
supported.markdownDescription: Whether navigator.storage.estimate() returned a usable measurement.
